name: Google News RSS
caveat: Twenty-seven region-specific queries produce leads only. Syndication, translation and headline matching can create false positives or duplicates.

name: GDELT DOC 2.1
caveat: A second public discovery provider reduces dependence on one news index. Every result still requires source, scope and duplicate review.

name: ArcBox public solar-fire index
caveat: Useful for breadth but affected by vendor, language and editorial selection bias; reports stay unverified until incident-level review.

name: QBE Europe solar-fire research
caveat: Freedom-of-information totals can overlap official statistics and are never added to incident totals.

name: FM property loss-prevention data sheets
caveat: Engineering guidance helps identify failure modes and terminology; it is not an incident register.

name: IEA PVPS Task 13
caveat: Technical reports inform review vocabulary and causation checks but do not automatically create incident records.

name: Japan Consumer Safety Investigation Commission
caveat: Commission investigations are reviewed for installed-PV relevance, date-window fit and possible overlap with prior summaries.

name: Japan NITE product-accident information
caveat: Product notices are leads only; recalls or tests without an installed-system fire are excluded.

name: Korea National Fire Agency
caveat: Only installed-PV incidents with a public, traceable source enter review; battery-only events remain excluded.

name: Energy Safe Victoria
caveat: Consultations can aggregate overlapping fire-service records and remain separate from incident totals.
